title: Only controls a young child understands
statement: Leave off a young child's media player any control they can't interpret, such as skip-five-seconds buttons, and give one large play and pause control instead.
detail: A review of a Grade 3 reading course's film player asked for its skip-five-seconds buttons to go, since a third grader would have no idea what they mean. The ruling requires one large play and pause overlay with no seek buttons and no native controls in any mode, and it corrected in place the redesign that had added them. No outcome was measured.

evidence.quote: The video player must use the Aladdin-style large teal play/pause overlay with no +/-5s seek controls and no native controls, in any mode.
A 3rd grader has no model for what "+/-5s" means.
